products.who: 新建醫院／舊院改造／醫療園區
products.d: 建築、機電、空調、醫療氣體、設備、能源、消防、安全、維修、VMS。
遠距、多點、數據智控、能源、HVAC、影像、AIoT、Edge AI。

allTabs.label: 醫院
allTabs.title: 全院一張圖的智慧升級
allTabs.tagline: 建築、設備、照護環境與多院區，在同一張圖上管理。
allTabs.pain: 病床、醫療設備、空調、醫療氣體與保全各自一套系統；多院區資料分散，生命安全事件難以即時定位。
points: HIS／病床／排程與空間串接
MRI、CT、呼吸器、監護設備等醫材資產
跌倒、緊急事件、保全、消防等生命安全
電力、UPS、空調、醫療氣體、給排水、潔淨環境
多棟、多院區 Command Center

allTabs.label: 商場
allTabs.title: 從看營收到看整個場域
allTabs.tagline: 人流、交易、影像與設備資料連動。
allTabs.pain: 只看營收，看不到人流、空調負載與租戶能耗之間的關係，跨店也難以比較。
points: POS + 人流 + VMS + 停車 + 租戶 + 空調 + 能源
樓層、品牌、活動的人流、交易、轉換率與坪效
租戶能耗、公共區域能耗、空調負載聯動
AI 分析：人流 × 活動 × 天氣 × 銷售 × 能源

allTabs.label: 工廠
allTabs.title: 跨國工廠上帝視角
allTabs.tagline: 把工廠的人、機、料、法、環與能源放進同一個空間資料模型。
allTabs.pain: 各廠區使用不同顧問、不同表單、不同系統，總部無法用同一套 KPI 比較稼動、能耗與工安。
points: ERP／MES／SCADA／PLC／WMS 串接
設備稼動率 OEE、產能、停機與預防維護
產線別、設備別、產品別能耗與碳排
潔淨室、環境、安全與影像
跨國工廠 Benchmark 與總部上帝視角

allTabs.label: 辦公
allTabs.title: 設計到物業不斷鏈
allTabs.tagline: 竣工模型直接成為營運數位孿生。
allTabs.pain: 完工交付後資料斷裂，物業與管委會要重新建立一套設備、保固與維修資料。
points: 竣工模型轉為營運數位孿生
保固、修繕、公設與完整建築履歷
空調與照明節能排程
門禁、影像與設備告警整合

allTabs.label: 能源
allTabs.title: 從供電到用電的全域能源智控
allTabs.tagline: 把發電、儲能、負載與冷卻整合成多場站營運平台。
allTabs.pain: AI 伺服器拉高電力密度，冷卻與配電成為瓶頸；太陽能、風電與儲能多場站難以統一維運。
points: Solar PV：Module、String、Inverter、PR、日照
Wind：Turbine、Gearbox、振動、風速
ESS：BMS、PCS、SOC、SOH、Cell Temperature
資料中心：Rack、PDU、UPS、Cooling、PUE
Peak Shaving、Demand Response、發電預測

products.d: BIM, PMIS, facilities, energy, power, HVAC, cleanrooms, VMS, AIoT and Local AI.
Building, MEP, HVAC, medical gas, equipment, energy, fire, security, maintenance and VMS.
Remote, multi-site, data intelligence, energy, HVAC, video, AIoT and Edge AI.

allTabs.label: Hospitals
allTabs.title: One map for the whole hospital
allTabs.tagline: Buildings, equipment, care environments and campuses — managed on one map.
allTabs.pain: Beds, medical devices, HVAC, medical gas and security each run their own systems. Data is split across campuses, and life-safety events are hard to locate in real time.
points: HIS, beds and scheduling linked to space
Medical assets: MRI, CT, ventilators, monitors
Life safety: falls, emergencies, security, fire
Power, UPS, HVAC, medical gas, plumbing, clean rooms
Multi-building, multi-campus Command Center

allTabs.label: Retail
allTabs.title: Beyond revenue — see the whole venue
allTabs.tagline: Footfall, transactions, video and equipment data, all linked.
allTabs.pain: Looking only at revenue hides how footfall, HVAC load and tenant energy relate — and makes cross-store comparison hard.
points: POS + footfall + VMS + parking + tenants + HVAC + energy
Footfall, transactions, conversion and sales per area by floor, brand and event
Tenant vs. common-area energy and HVAC load
AI: footfall × events × weather × sales × energy

allTabs.label: Factories
allTabs.title: A god’s-eye view across global plants
allTabs.tagline: People, machines, materials, methods, environment and energy in one spatial model.
allTabs.pain: Each plant uses different consultants, forms and systems, so HQ can’t compare OEE, energy and safety on the same KPIs.
points: ERP / MES / SCADA / PLC / WMS integration
OEE, capacity, downtime and preventive maintenance
Energy and carbon by line, asset and product
Cleanrooms, environment, safety and video
Cross-plant benchmarking from HQ

allTabs.label: Offices
allTabs.title: No break from design to facility management
allTabs.tagline: The as-built model becomes the operational digital twin.
allTabs.pain: Data breaks at handover, and facility teams have to rebuild equipment, warranty and maintenance records from scratch.
points: As-built model becomes the operating twin
Warranty, repairs, common areas and full building history
HVAC and lighting energy scheduling
Access, video and equipment alarms integrated

allTabs.label: Energy
allTabs.title: Total energy control, from supply to demand
allTabs.tagline: Generation, storage, load and cooling as one multi-site operating platform.
allTabs.pain: AI servers push up power density, making cooling and distribution the bottleneck; multi-site solar, wind and storage are hard to operate as one.
points: Solar PV: modules, strings, inverters, PR, irradiance
Wind: turbines, gearboxes, vibration, wind speed
ESS: BMS, PCS, SOC, SOH, cell temperature
Data centers: racks, PDU, UPS, cooling, PUE
Peak shaving, demand response, generation forecasting
